title: Compact mech: new textures, more detail
desc: Three new compact mechs (0.6 size, for a villager or small mob) for 821 MS (IMPROVE: "Different texture, more detailed designs for the robots"): each has its own texture (not X3D1), panels, joints, pistons, sensors and vents, and forms, moves and attacks its own way.

takes.name: Workhorse
takes.facts: W1 weave, 0.6 size, stocky biped loader: sensor head, chest core, radiator and exhaust stacks, vents, pistons on knees/ankles/elbows, ram forearms with 3-finger hands; printed by a rising scan plane; march; piston punch; double ram slam; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Crawler
takes.facts: V1 crystal, 0.6 size, four-legged walker: five-eye sensor cluster, pod with glass sensor dome, crystal spikes, pincer arms with hydraulic jaws, leg pistons; grows like crystal joint by joint; trot; pincer lunge; rear-up stomp with a ring of crystal spikes; baby zombie pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Treadline
takes.facts: R2K1 dark jade, 0.6 size, tracked mini-mech: twin treads with moving cleats, turret cockpit, headlights, spinning radar dish, exhausts, anchors, drill arm + grab claw; assembled on rails; drive and pivot turn; drill bursts a stone pillar; anchored turret spin; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126
